seo.title: Docito® Pharmacies — E-Prescriptions, Inventory, Refills, Delivery & Insurance Workflows
seo.description: Docito® for Pharmacies unifies e-prescription intake, inventory and dispensing, refill automation, patient notifications, delivery coordination, and audit-ready compliance—securely connecting pharmacies with doctors, clinics, patients, labs, and insurance.
seo.keywords: pharmacy management system, e-prescription platform, prescription dispensing software, pharmacy inventory management, refill automation, medication delivery coordination, automatic superbill generation, billing documentation, HIPAA compliant pharmacy software, multilingual healthcare SaaS

hero.description: Run pharmacy operations end-to-end: e-prescription intake, inventory and dispensing, refill workflows, delivery coordination, analytics, and compliance—built for secure collaboration across the Docito® healthcare ecosystem.
hero.trustNote: Compliance-first, HIPAA/GDPR-ready architecture with role-based access control and audit trails.
